announcements.headline: Management accounts to 30 Jun 2026 and 31 Dec 2025
announcements.insight: NYCE's release of full-year accounts for the period ending June 2026 provides critical visibility into its post-acquisition integration with Symbio and performance in the volatile UK waste management sector. The timing suggests a focus on validating the strategic pivot towards higher-margin recycling and circular economy assets amidst tightening environmental regulations.

announcements.headline: Result of AGM

announcements.headline: Corporate & Trading Update
announcements.insight: NYCE International's update reflects the ongoing challenges in the UK SME market with modest revenue growth but persistent margin pressure, typical of small-cap IT distributors navigating inflationary costs and client caution.

announcements.headline: Share Capital Reorganisation & Notice of AGM
announcements.insight: This is a standard administrative filing for NYCE International to facilitate the upcoming Annual General Meeting and execute routine share capital reorganisation, likely involving minor consolidation or cancellation of nominal value rather than substantive strategic shifts.
